author: upfront
quote: Genuinely the worst storyline in the GTA series. Jason's character is bland and his voicelines sound forced almost like someone is squeezing his balls at all times. We are supposed to like this girl boss character but she doesn't have any redeeming qualities about herself, she literally abandoned her infant child to go rob a store. You are forced to play Jason like a lost puppy doing chores for the girl that abandoned him with his child, in the first 5-6 hours of the game. The physics of the game do not match the expectations of 2 billion dollar game, hell they don't even match the expectations with GTA 5. 30fps is UNACCEPTABLE for 2026 gaming and to make matters worse you can't even get constant 30fps. The game has 0 replayability value. Hopefully GTA online is a banger they can't possibly **** up races and minigames that much right???
